scope: Shared common-tube predicate and record replay for the single already-selected archived R3 proof. Does not rerun or alter the R3 native evaluator.
memory_cap: not separately enforced; exact-rational bit/operation/wall caps apply
retry_policy: one declared common-adapter profile; no cap change or retry under this profile
selection_binding: reuse the R3 record ID and both record hashes frozen before the first common-check result
